working: Outside the sphere, the field is the same as that of a point charge Q at the centre. By energy conservation, the kinetic energy gained equals the loss in potential energy: (1/2)mv² = kQq(1/R − 1/3R) = 2kQq/(3R). So v² = 4kQq/(3mR). With k = 1/(4πε0), v² = Qq/(3πε0 mR), giving v = √(Qq/(3πε0 mR)).
